description:
Team Heavy is a passionate team of curious problem-solvers interested in technology, innovation, and building impactful solutions. We enjoy web development, creative thinking, and exploring new technologies. Our goal is to turn ideas into practical projects and make the most of every hackathon.

We're looking for enthusiastic team members skilled in programming, web development, UI/UX design, data analysis, and creative problem-solving. Most importantly, we value teamwork and dedication.
